description:
## Implementation plan

Loaded `test-coverage-planner` and reviewed the requested policies, live Serena symbols, and existing tests. **Planning only:** no edits, test execution, Git mutations, or Beadwork mutations performed; existing edits preserved. **Action reuse: N/A—tests only.**

### Test ownership

Add **`test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/providers/codex_test.exs`**, module `Zaq.Agent.ProviderSpec.Providers.CodexTest`, using `ExUnit.Case, async: true` and `ExUnitProperties`.

Existing shared owners:
- `test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/registry_test.exs`: registry selection, callback availability, basic Codex translation and reserved-identity removal.
- `test/zaq/agent/provider_spec_test.exs`: facade normalization, resolved-token/account pairing, advanced-option precedence.
- `test/zaq/agent/factory_test.exs`: runtime assembly and trusted credential resolution; `async: false`.

Keep new provider-specific cases in the dedicated file; coordinator owns any shared-suite changes.

### Helpers and isolation

Define local `context(overrides \\ %{})`, merging overrides into:

`%{provider: "openai_codex", runtime_provider: :openai_codex, endpoint: nil, metadata: %{}, auth_kind: "oauth2", authentication: %{access_token: "selected-token"}, runtime_identity: %{}}`.

Reuse the existing registry tests’ context shape. No shared fixture extraction, database, Mox, HTTP fake, processes, environment changes, or production hooks are needed. Calls are synchronous; no waits or sleeps. Tokens are synthetic.

### Exact scenarios and assertions

| Missed line | Inputs and required assertions |
|---|---|
| **14** | Call `Codex.fixed_url_provider?/1` with `"openai_codex"` and `:openai_codex`; assert each result **`=== false`**. This protects configurable model endpoints. |
| **20** | Start with `spec = %{provider: :openai_codex, id: "gpt-5.3-codex-spark", marker: :keep}`. For `endpoint: nil` and `endpoint: ""`, assert `Codex.put_model_spec(spec, context) === spec`. Repeat with an existing `base_url: "https://existing.example"` to prove preservation. Positive control: `"https://custom.example/backend-api"` replaces `base_url` while every other field survives. |
| **38** | Call `Codex.default_advanced_options/1` with `%{}`, then `%{provider: "openai_codex", supports_logprobs: true}`, and the corresponding false configuration. Assert exact `%{}` throughout: Codex must not inherit generic logprob defaults. |
| **44** | Table-test `provider_options: nil`, `%{"chatgpt_account_id" => "untrusted"}`, and `"invalid"`. Include top-level `temperature: 0.4` and `api_key: "stale"`. Assert temperature preserved, access token `"selected-token"`, top-level OAuth mode, default backend URL, absent API key, and exact nested `[auth_mode: :oauth]`. Repeat the map case with selected identity `"acct_person"` and configured originator `"zaqos"`; assert exactly those three nested options via `Map.new/1` plus length three. |

### Invariant and reachability

Add a bounded property generating 1–40-character alphanumeric endpoint suffixes: replacing `base_url` preserves `Map.delete(spec, :base_url)` exactly.

All four lines are reachable through public callbacks. Nonbinary endpoints are outside the declared context contract; malformed lists are outside keyword-list expectations. Do not manufacture crashes to chase coverage.

### Coordinator validation

Run through Context Mode:

1. `mix q`
2. `mix test test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/providers/codex_test.exs test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/registry_test.exs test/zaq/agent/provider_spec_test.exs test/zaq/agent/factory_test.exs`
3. Coverage phase: `mix coveralls.json` (600,000 ms), then `mix coverup` only on success.
4. Final gate: `mix precommit` (900,000 ms).

Confirm all four lines covered; target ≥95%. E2E unnecessary for pure translation tests.

### Coordinator override

Implement only the owned test file: `test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/providers/codex_test.exs`. No Mix commands, Git/Beadwork changes, or full-suite runs by the worker. No production changes. The coordinator will run `mix q` and `mix test` for edited/added test files only with `--cover` (for this plan: `mix test test/zaq/agent/provider_spec/providers/codex_test.exs --cover`). This override supersedes the validation execution instructions above.


Coordinator execution override: tests only in assigned files, preserve pre-existing edits; no worker Mix/Git/Beadwork mutations. Coordinator alone runs mix q and added/edited tests --cover. No full-suite or precommit execution for this coverage task.
